headline: Week 10: Ja'Marr Chase Personally Files A Restraining Order Against The Rest Of The League
subhead: Hot Cocks dropped 173, Olave Garden hung a 50-burger, and Put an AR to My Head finally pulled the trigger on their own season.
matchOfTheWeek: Hot Cocks 173.68 vs LargestofRocks 122.32 should've been competitive — Largest dropped 122 and STILL got bodied by 51. Why? Because Ja'Marr Chase put up 55.40 by himself, which is more than half of what AR's entire roster scored. Oh, and Largest left 39.18 on the bench with Will Levis and Rachaad White rotting in street clothes — the only thing more efficient than Hot Cocks' 100% lineup was Largest's commitment to self-sabotage.
mainRecap:
Let's start where the carnage started: Ja'Marr Chase went thermonuclear for 55.40 and Hot Cocks posted a perfect 100% efficiency 173.68, which is the fantasy equivalent of dunking on a 7-year-old and then stealing his lunch money. Meanwhile LargestofRocks scored 122 — a winning number in most weeks — and still got curb-stomped by 51 because he benched a 19-point Will Levis and a 19-point Rachaad White. Bro, you had the optimal score of 161 sitting in your pocket and chose violence against yourself.

Over in Sadness Corner, Put an AR to My Head mustered a league-low 98.18 while Derek Carr dropped 20.46 on his bench. KyleDech, you're not just losing — you're losing CREATIVELY. The Olave Garden hung 150.72 on him with Burrow (33.72) and Kelce (24.40) doing Burrow-and-Kelce things, and Patrick didn't even need to break a sweat.

226 Alpha smoked Bo Nix Celli 149-106 behind Hurts' 30.68, though Celli at least got 29.40 from Bijan and a random 25.90 MVS spike that nobody saw coming, including MVS's own quarterback. The Good Ladds rode Kyler's 28.74 to a 128-107 win over MassiveCocks, because of course Mig found the one week Kyler decides to remember he's an MVP. T Swift's Baddies edged OnlyFants 130-113 behind Lamar's 32.90 — Cubby, your team is good and you still can't beat the Swifties, that's gotta sting.

And in the Sleepy Bowl of the Week, Jets' Juniors beat Stroud Boys 118-98 in a game so aesthetically offensive it should've been blacked out locally. Calvin Ridley's 25.40 was the only thing keeping Wunder's win from being deeply embarrassing. Stroud Boys, meanwhile, left Metchie's 18.40 on the bench — fitting punishment for naming your team after the QB you can't even start anymore.

powerRankings.blurb: 100% lineup efficiency, 173 points, and a Ja'Marr Chase that's currently auditioning for the Hall of Fame — BigD is operating on a different frequency.
Burrow + Kelce + a 52-point blowout — Patrick is quietly stacking dubs while everyone else fights over scraps.
Lamar Jackson keeps printing 30-burgers and Tnicolle keeps cashing them — annoyingly consistent, like the music she's named after.
Mig wins the week Kyler Murray decides to be elite again — pure cosmic luck wrapped in a 128-point bow.
Beat Celli by 43 with Hurts going off, but left Russell Wilson's 19 on the bench because nobody actually trusts Russell Wilson, including szara.
Cubby scored 113 and still lost — the team is good, the timing is cursed, and Week 10 was just confirmation.
Won the ugliest game of the week with a 118-spot and Calvin Ridley duct-taping the lineup together.
107 against The Good Ladds isn't embarrassing, but it isn't winning football either — stuck in fantasy purgatory.
Bijan and a random MVS eruption couldn't save Celli from a 43-point sledgehammer to the face.
Scored 122 and lost by 51 with 39 points on the bench — a masterclass in how to be both unlucky AND bad at this.
98 points, Metchie rotting on the bench, and a team name that gets sadder every week C.J. plays.
